name: @hl-bos/jersey-sort
description: JerseySort AI engine. Decides which numbers in a sports photo are jersey numbers (and which are scoreboards, yard markers or signs), classifies every reading into high / medium / low confidence against configurable thresholds, decides whether a photo needs a human, parses search queries, and defines the swappable ImageAnalysisProvider boundary with a Claude vision provider. No database, no filesystem, no image decoding: every decision the product makes is testable here.
